text_block_list.text:
Symboli Kris S's Senior Year
is finally about to begin—

Symboli Kris S came to Hatsumode on Zenno Rob Roy's invitation,
and I accompanied them as their chaperone.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: “—Thank you so very much for making time for me so early in the new year!”

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――No problem.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Events like this in Japan... are important.
...I am grateful for the opportunity.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...!
If that's the case, then I'm glad.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
âAh, looks like it just cleared up.
Shall we go right ahead and pay our respects?
choice_data_list: What will Symboli Kris S wish for?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
A prayer...—I see.
Putting one's hands together—so that's what it means.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Hmm.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
Just for... reference—if it were you—
I want to know what you would wish for.
What I was thinking on my end was—
choice_data_list: Praying for good health
Phenomenal growth.
Ward against misfortune

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Then, I too... shall make the same wish.
choice_data_list: Don't you have a wish of your own, Symboli Kris S?
Don't you have a personal wish, Symboli Kris S?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—Fulfilling my mission.
That is... my wish as well. ...However—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
The one who will make it come true—is myself.
—That is what I believe.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
So—if I am to make a wish—
I thought Trainer's wish—would be best.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Besides—health is important.
choice_data_list: ...If that's the case, let's ask together!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Then, I too... shall make the same wish.

text_block_list.text:
—Fulfilling my mission.
That is... my wish as well. ...However—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
The one who will make it come true—is myself.
—That is what I believe.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
So—if I am to make a wish—
I thought Trainer's wish—would be best.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Besides—growth is certainly necessary.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Then, I too... shall make the same wish.

Don't you have a personal wish, Symboli Kris S?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—Fulfilling my mission.
That is... my wish as well. ...However—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
The one who will make it come true—is myself.
—That is what I believe.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
So—if I am to make a wish—
I thought Trainer's wish—would be best.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Besides, misfortune—is hard luck.
—Difficult—for us to avoid.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Wishing to ward off misfortune...
is, I believe, rational.
choice_data_list: ...If that's the case, let's ask together!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Yeah.

And so, making the same wish
as Symboli Kris S, our New Year's visit ended—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
“—Well then, I have to return to the dorm after this,
so I'll be taking my leave here.”

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much again for today...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
—Likewise.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: "...Um! Kris S-san!"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Mmh...?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I'll... do my best in the Classic year!
I'll give it my all and show real "results"—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I'll become strong enough—
to one day catch up to you, Kris S-san!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――……I see.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...Understood.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...Please wait for me!
Someday, without fail—in a race!!
Heading to the Trainer's Room to hold a meeting with Symboli Kris S—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —That came as a bit of a surprise.
choice_data_list: What do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
It's Rob Roy. —To think that she wants to catch up to me—
I didn't know.
choice_data_list: It just means your run was that incredible.
That just shows what an incredible run you had

text_block_list.text: The "results" Symboli Kris S has demonstrated along the path up to today are undeniably influencing those around her.
I felt that those words from Zenno Rob Roy were yet another piece of proof...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...Regarding our goals for the Senior Year--
I have a proposal.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
First—the Takarazuka Kinen.
...I will show "results" here.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Yet—for me, this "Takarazuka Kinen" is—
a preliminary skirmish—heading into autumn.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Our next target—the Tenno Sho (Autumn).
choice_data_list: ...! In that case, what to aim for is—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Back-to-back victories at the Tenno Sho (Autumn).
"It would be a historic feat that no one has ever accomplished before. Truly a 'result' that will go down in history...!"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"No one has—achieved it—yet.
I will seize—that 'result.'"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
With this, I want to—
powerfully demonstrate—
that I am at the pinnacle.
choice_data_list: That's an awesome plan!
That's a fantastic plan!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――Thanks.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
......When Rob Roy――
said――that she would 'grow stronger'――

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...I was a little surprised.
And at the same time—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: I felt that... I, too, must do everything in my power.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...So that I won't—betray her.
choice_data_list: Let's do our best so that we can remain a role model.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Yeah.
With a refreshed mindset, and with sights set first on the Takarazuka Kinen, the battles of the Senior Year were underway!
